quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: For 'light,' touch your tongue tip to the ridge behind your top teeth; for 'right,' curl your tongue back without touching anything.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "light." The /l/ is made by touching the tongue tip to the ridge behind the teeth, letting air flow around the sides. "Right" would curl the tongue tip up and back, not touching anything, for the /r/.
quests.vowelTensionRule: For /l/, the tongue tip touches the ridge behind the top teeth. For /r/, the tongue curls back without touching anything.
quests.mouthPosition: Lips relaxed, tongue slightly lower and relaxed.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.

quests.vowelTensionRule: /l/ makes full contact with the roof of the mouth; /r/ stays clear of it, with the tongue pulled back and the lips slightly rounded.
quests.mouthPosition: Lips relaxed, tongue slightly lower and relaxed.
